# Swarups NXT

> Swarups NXT is an AI integration partner based in Chennai, India. It sets up, customises and supports bulk WhatsApp and RCS messaging, enterprise SMS and OTP, AI voice agents, AI chatbots and automation for businesses of any industry across India, so businesses can reach customers at scale and get replies answered 24x7 on WhatsApp, SMS, phone, website chat and social media — in English, Hindi and other major Indian languages.

Swarups NXT handles the setup, training and ongoing support; clients do not need a technical team. Typical setup takes a few weeks, depending on scope. There are no fixed plans: pricing is based on volume per channel (per message for WhatsApp, RCS and SMS; per seat for the contact center) and a custom quote is shared after a discovery call.

## Products

- Bulk WhatsApp & RCS Engine: bulk messages to opted-in contacts with rich media and personalisation; AI answers replies; delivered/read/replied reporting.
- Enterprise SMS & OTP: OTPs, transaction alerts and promotional SMS at volume, with delivery reports; help setting up the client's DLT sender IDs and templates.
- AI Voice Agents: answer inbound calls and make follow-up calls 24x7 in Indian languages; hand over to staff when a person is needed.
- AI Chatbots: answer questions, capture leads and book appointments on WhatsApp and websites.
- Voice Blast: send a recorded or AI-voiced message to many phones at once, with press-a-key (IVR) responses and call reports.
- AI Contact Center: AI handles routine calls and chats; human agents take the conversations that need a person.
- Omnichannel Bots: one AI assistant across phone, WhatsApp, website chat and social media.
- Social Media Bots: automatic replies to Instagram and Facebook comments and DMs; turns interested followers into leads.
- SaaS Automation: automates repetitive work such as lead entry, reminders and status updates.

## Industries served

Real estate, healthcare and clinics, education, e-commerce and D2C, finance and NBFC collections, automobile dealers, hospitality.

## Languages

English and common Indian languages, including Hinglish. Exact coverage depends on the product and channel.

## How it works

1. Discovery call
2. Custom setup and training
3. Go live and optimise
